description: Throughput floor for the CI capacity smoke gate. hardware_agnostic_rps is successful requests per server CPU-second, so the threshold is host-independent; the floor is deliberately far below local measurements to tolerate shared-runner noise. Raise it only with a CI run that records a stable value.

recorded.note: Floor seeded conservatively at ~12% of the local reference measurement below; it is not a CI-runner measurement.
